propositions: Reconciler core modules pass transport objects as unannotated or shim-path-imported parameters, defeating mypy's attribute checking and allowing missing members to ship silently
Absolute imports via rebar_reconciler.* are resolved to Any by mypy due to ignore_missing_imports, rendering any port-type annotation through that path blind despite appearing correct in code review

Relative imports of TicketTransport within the reconciler package restore mypy's [attr-defined] enforcement, enabling detection of capability members (add_comment, set_relationship) and genuine port gaps that the AST audit cannot structurally see

Four capability call sites (dispatch_one.py:465,667,752 and dispatch_apply_phases.py:165) reach for opt-in members unconditionally without runtime guards, resolvable by narrowing to composed Protocols rather than adding members to the port body
A test guard must detect and reject bare, Any-annotated, or shim-path-imported transport parameters to prevent future ratchet-driven changes from silently reintroducing the blindness
